description: What a price move of 1, 2, 5, 10 or 20 % each way would liquidate for one coin: the tracked Hyperliquid notional and positions whose liquidation price each move reaches, per band and cumulative, with the largest positions and (on paid plans) the resting order book in the same range. Use it for "how much gets liquidated if BTC drops 5 %?". move adds one custom move (paid plans).

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

move.description: A custom move in percent, e.g. -7.5 (a 7.5 % fall) or 3 (a 3 % rise), on a 0.5 % grid. Pro, Desk or an API plan; without a key or with a free key it answers plan_required.

name: get_stress_test

bands.description: Per move (fraction): price, side, band and cumulative (usd, positions, wallets, share, depthUsd, depthComplete, largest).

depthIncluded.description: Whether the plan includes the book depth per band.

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

mapped.description: positions, usd with a reachable liquidation price.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

tracked.description: positions, wallets, usd, longUsd, shortUsd, openInterestUsd, coverage.

title: Liquidation stress test
